race.name: Haunted Halloween Half Marathon & 5km
race.description:
2025 results: https://www.athlinks.com/event/314344/results/Event/1099091/Results

 

The Haunted Halloween Half Marathon & 5km returns this fall to Chicago's Lincoln Park, at a new site! We will be in Diversey Event Space, across the street from Notebaert Nature Museum. The event offers race distances of half marathon and 5K ― with a special Halloween twist! Hundreds of runners and walkers of all ages and abilities dress in costume and compete for fun and prizes. Age group awards will be given in ten-year age ranges. And there is prize money for the winners of our pre-race Costume Contest! Costume Contest Prize Money:  For the teams 1st, 2nd win $200 and for individuals 1st, 2nd win $100.  

After the race, help yourself to some autumn refreshment treats. There will of course be Halloween candy. Every HM & 5k finisher gets a H^3 medal to match your bib and shirt! Please attend our post party with a free beer at Tin Lizzie in Lincoln Park where they will also be offering 20% discount on their food menu. 

Course will traverse the trails within Lincoln Park before heading south along Chicago's scenic Lakefront Trail. Course is accurately measured with every mile marked. Timing splits on the HM course at 5km, 10km, 10mi. ***the 10km split has been moved to the TURNAROUND point at 6.55miles***

Participants are encouraged to use public transportation. If you choose to drive, parking is available in the Chicago History Museum lot, or along Cannon Drive.

Packet Pickups are being scheduled for Fleet Feet & Xtra Mile Running as well as on raceday, on site, beginning at 7:15am! Tentative schedule below. 

TBD, @ Fleet Feet CHICAGO

Sunday, 10/25, 7:15-8:35am @ Diversey Event Space (2611 N Cannon Dr, Chicago, IL)

This event will sell out.

Schedule: 7:15am - PPU and Gear Check open ... 7:45am - Costume Contest Judging at stage ... 8:05am - Costume Winners decided ... 8:30am - HALF MARATHON Start ... 8:45am - 5k Start ... 9:10am - 5k winners ... 10:05am - HM winners ... 12:50pm - Gear Check closed

Age group awards will be given in ten year categories: 19 & under, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+

race.name: HOW 5K
race.description:
About the Event:

HOW is thrilled to invite you to join us for our annual 5K run/walk, held this year on October 18th at Horner Park on Chicago’s North Side. All ages and abilities are welcome to run, walk, jog, or stroll the course. Check-in will open at 9AM and the run/walk will start at 10AM. Following the completion of the run/walk, we'll have an afterparty with food and drinks at Irving Park Pizza & Patio from 11AM-1PM. 

Housing is a human right. That's the belief at the heart of everything we do at HOW. As federal funding grows increasingly uncertain, it's our community — people like you — who make it possible to keep our neighbors housed.  

That's where the 2026 HOW 5K comes in. For years, this event has rallied people from across the city all in service of one goal: keeping our neighbors housed. This year, that support matters more than ever. Lace up, show up, and stand with your community. Your neighbors are counting on you.

Every Registrant Helps Provide: 

  • Permanent Housing: Individuals and families move from homelessness into safe, stable housing they can call home. 
  • Case Management: One-on-one support that helps clients overcome barriers and build long-term stability. 
  • Employment Services: Job coaching, resume assistance, and career development that help clients increase their income and regain independence. 
  • Health Care Support: Connects clients with health insurance, primary care, and ongoing health services so they can stay healthy and remain housed. 
  • Family & Youth Services: Helps children and parents access tutoring, youth programs, school support, and resources the whole family needs.
  • Support Against Rising Housing Costs: Helps keep people housed as rents and costs (like security deposits) keep climbing year after year.

race.name: Cyclocross for Everyone! -- 10/31/2026 -- THE MARSH MONSTER Halloween Race
race.description:
A: Our most competitive category. Consider it a “Pro/Cat1/2 Race”. All legal race tactics welcome, this is about competing with each other respectfully and pushing each other as hard as we can.

B: Our less advanced competitive category. Consider it a “Cat 3/4" Race. This also encompasses anyone who has a goal to compete beyond what the C race would allow. If people who are just trying racing want to race for less than 45 minutes, they can always drop out early.

C: Fun only, it’s not results-focused. It is also completely unlabeled in terms of gender. This will be about the side quest, or about the hand-ups, or about trying something for the first time without the pressure of also competing at it. Any level is welcome, but everyone has to remember that this is about letting other people have their good time without getting in their way. If you go fast, that’s fine, but give all the slower people room to ride (or abruptly stop for whipped cream).

race.name: Lincolnwood Turkey Trot: 5K, 10K, Walk, Dash
race.description:
Be part of the tradition.

The annual Lincolnwood Turkey Trot is a chip-timed, USATF certified 5K and 10K race. This flat and fast course weaves through scenic Lincolnwood and features races for all ages and abilities, including a 5K Fitness Walk and Kid's Drumstick Dash (ages six and younger). Everyone that crosses the Finish Line will receive a finisher medal!

events.name: 5K Run
events.details:
Race Village, Start, and Finish: Proesel Park, 7055 N. Kostner Avenue (near Proesel Park Family Aquatic Center)

The 5K (USATF Certification Number IL-23031-NM) and 10K (USATF Certification Number IL-23032-NM) courses will be marked on the road and with signs along the route. Course cut-off time is 10:20am.

For participant's safety, no bicycles, in-line skates or other-wheeled vehicles, except wheelchairs or other accessibility devices. 

Strollers and baby joggers are allowed, but all runners with strollers or baby joggers must start at the back of the race corral. 

Animals are not permitted on the racecourse or in Proesel Park. Service animals must be registered at least one week before race day, please contact the Race Director at jglowacki@lwd.org

All pre-registered runners and walkers will receive a long-sleeve running shirt. (Adult shirts are designed by men’s sizes.) Lincolnwood Turkey Trot finisher medals will be awarded to all registered runners and walkers who cross the finish line.

Overall winners will be awarded by the gun time start, and age division winners will be awarded off of the chip time. Race medals will be awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in each distance, age division, and male and female. Additionally, awards will be given to top male and female Lincolnwood resident finishers in each distance, and top male and female overall winners in each distance.

Packet pick-up will be held at the Lincolnwood Community Center (4170 Morse Ave, Lincolnwood, IL 60712) as follows:

Thursday, November 19: 9 am - 7 pm
Friday, November 20: 7 am - 5 pm
Saturday, November 21: 9 am - 2 pm
Sunday, November 22: (Race Day): 6:30 am in the race village near Proesel Park Family Aquatic Center

Early packet pickup is strongly encouraged. Packets will include a Turkey Trot long-sleeved shirt, race bib, and pins. 

Packet pickup for fellow runners is allowed. For groups of four or more runners, please write down each name in your party to assist staff. Shirt sizes may be exchanged following the race.

race.name: Santa Hustle Chicago
race.description: The Santa Hustle Race Series is more than just a run—it’s a magical holiday experience filled with festive fun, Christmas cheer, and a whole lot of Santa spirit! Runners of all ages and abilities are invited to join this winter wonderland race, featuring a scenic course, holiday music, and sweet treats like candy canes and cookies along the way. Whether you're dashing through the snow for a PR or just in it for the holiday vibes, the Santa Hustle is the perfect way to celebrate the season with family, friends, and fellow festive runners!
